protocol.geometry_policy: fixed installed wall; excluded holds remain collision geometry
protocol.anchor_policy: shared four starting contacts and matched TOP; generated start/finish become hand candidates
protocol.random_policy: seeded shared permutation within surface-permission strata; all anchors fixed; joint hand/foot roles and effective limb counts preserved
protocol.repeat_policy: identical effective contact masks share one search result; every proposal remains in the denominator
protocol.ranking: complete and P0 pass first, release feasible fraction descending, peak accumulated load ascending
limitations: One wall with 18 holds; no estimate of generalization.
V grades are model conditions, not verified route grades.
Discrete skeleton and synthetic static/load checks; human forerunning required.
Budget-limited search failure is not proof of impossibility.
